eventDetail.scope: ICDT-2026 is envisioned as a premier international forum for academicians, researchers, industry professionals, and students to exchange ideas and research outcomes in disruptive technologies, including but not limited to: • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning • Software Engineering and Advanced Computing • Blockchain Technologies • Internet of Things (IoT) • Cybersecurity and Secure Systems • Cloud, Edge, and Distributed Computing • Intelligent Communications and Networks The conference program will comprise keynote lectures, invited talks, panel discussions, and rigorously peer-reviewed technical paper sessions, addressing both theoretical advancements and real-world applications. Strong emphasis is placed on student engagement, research mentoring, and skill development, in alignment with IEEE CS’s mission of professional growth and knowledge dissemination.
